title: diag.8: display — SPI contention correlation detector
description: Track radio CRC error rate in 500ms windows. If error rate during display refresh is >5x baseline: adapt by auto-deferring all subsequent display updates to TDMA guard windows (no TX/RX during refresh). Report DIAG_DISPLAY_SPI_ADAPT. This is permanent for the session — once detected, the firmware never refreshes during active slots again.
